From: Alex Thompson <alex@perch.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quick hosted API eval request — Perch AI

Hi Soojin,

I signed up for the Hosted API sandbox this morning (Perch AI) and we’d like a brief walkthrough focused on latency and cost controls for our summarization pipeline. We’re an early PLG team trying to validate a prototype — 30 minutes would be perfect.

Availability this week: Mon/Tue afternoon PST or Wed morning PST.

Also attaching a very small anonymized sample of typical docs for context.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Thompson
Head of Data Platforms, Perch AI
alex@perch.ai
[attachment: sample-docs.tar.gz (referenced)]

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 15 Jun 2025 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API eval request — Perch AI

Hi Alex — great to meet you over email. Welcome!

We can definitely do a 30-minute focused session to walk through performance knobs, batching recommendations, and a quick sandbox run. Two windows that work for our PLG engineers:
- Tue Jun 17, 1:30–2:00 PM PT
- Wed Jun 18, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

I’ve attached a quick prep checklist (demo-prep-checklist.pdf) — if you can drop a couple example prompts and an expected throughput target, we’ll tailor the session.

If neither slot works, reply with a couple alternatives and Diego will loop in calendar invites.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
PLG Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[attachment: demo-prep-checklist.pdf (1 page)]

From: Alex Thompson <alex@perch.ai>

Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quick hosted API eval request — Perch AI

Thanks, Soojin — appreciate the quick reply. Wed 9:00–9:30 AM PT would be better for our engineering lead (Sheila). Can we make that slot but move it 15 min later (9:15) to avoid a calendar conflict on our side?

We expect ~3 concurrent users with bursts to 10 requests/sec. I attached a short security checklist our legal team asked to see (perch-security-qc.xlsx) — not a full compliance packet, just the list they run through early-stage vendors.

If 9:15 looks tight on your side, happy to keep Tue 1:30.

Best,
Alex
